pages.finding: Visual contact-sheet review: form title, field rules, checkboxes, taxpayer boxes and lower instructions retain the reference layout. Native small-text strokes and thin rules are lighter and glyph edges differ. Freeze the measured difference as a regression boundary; no form-fidelity or render-parity grant.

Visual contact-sheet review: two-column instructions, headings and paragraph blocks retain their positions. Dense body text has different stroke density and edge rasterization. Accept only this identified baseline's difference boundary.

Visual contact-sheet review: two-column instructions and the upper-right name table remain visible with aligned major blocks. Small glyphs and table-rule rasterization differ; this is a known baseline difference, not an equality result.

Visual contact-sheet review: blue cover, title, central illustrated band and NIST mark retain their placement. Fine illustration edges and text rasterization differ. Retain the baseline-bound external difference only.

Visual contact-sheet review: Executive Summary body, cyan definition box and page footer retain the reference layout. Differences concentrate on glyph strokes and box/text edges. Record as a regression baseline, without parity.

Visual contact-sheet review: risk discussion, section heading, paragraphs and footer remain in matching major blocks. Glyph antialiasing and stroke density differ. Freeze the observed difference rather than asserting identical typography.

Visual contact-sheet review: colored framework wheel, central labels, cover image and title band are retained. Fine image texture, color edges and text rasterization differ. No colorimetric or pixel-parity claim.

Visual contact-sheet review: overview heading, nested bullets, blue links and footer retain their positions. Text strokes and link/underline edges differ. Accept only the pinned baseline's measured boundary.

Visual contact-sheet review: four ascending tier blocks, tier labels, figure caption, paragraphs and blue links are retained. Thin graphic boundaries and glyph strokes differ. Freeze a difference-regression boundary only.

Visual contact-sheet review: title, planets, image framing, NASA mark and bottom legend retain the reference composition. Native illustration tones are visibly cooler in places and image/text edges differ. Preserve this known color/raster difference; no color-fidelity or parity grant.

Visual contact-sheet review: three resource columns, headings, italic links and footer retain the reference layout. Small-text stroke density and raster edges differ. Record only a bounded regression baseline.

Visual contact-sheet review: planetary composition, labels, framing and caption remain visible. Native dark background and planets have a visibly different blue/gray balance from Poppler, plus image-edge differences. This known baseline color difference remains open for fidelity work; it is not a parity pass.

review_method: Root visually inspected all twelve cloud-generated contact sheets: full-page thumbnails plus the recorded original-size crop, with 128-color diagnostic quantization. Full original 72dpi PPM hashes are bound below; diagnostic thumbnails do not replace those originals.
review_scope: Pinned external-difference regression boundaries and exact same-engine route RGBA/UTF-8/position signatures; not a full-document visual correctness, color-fidelity, mature-engine parity, or cross-platform performance acceptance.
